scope: Exploratory automatic scan-window screening; no_rule_flag is not validated usable time. Whole-log results were known before these rules were fixed.

protocol.scope: Exploratory automatic scan-window screening; no_rule_flag is not validated usable time. Whole-log results were known before these rules were fixed.
protocol.duration_accounting: Sum actual window durations, including final partial windows. Artifact support is separately unioned within each run; it is not whole flagged-window time.
protocol.ppg_comparison: Run-local offline slope detector and bandpass peak detector from the same waveform and sample-hold preprocessing; neither is independent ECG truth. Detection is performed once per padded run, not reset in every 30-second window.
protocol.event_count_disagreement_fraction: Absolute event-count difference divided by larger count; an exploratory review hint, not a main waveform-QC gate or an event-matching accuracy metric.

example_selection.eligible: Fully covered 30-second cardiac windows after the first 30 scan seconds, at least 10 events from each detector; no nonfinite/out-of-range samples and not unusable.
example_selection.clear: Lowest ADC boundary fraction among no_rule_flag windows with event-count difference <=5%; tie by manifest/run/window order. Visual review remains required.
example_selection.clipping: Highest positive ADC boundary fraction among eligible windows; absent if none.
example_selection.disagreement: Largest positive detector count difference among eligible no_rule_flag windows with ADC boundary fraction <=1%; fallback to eligible positive-difference windows if absent.
example_selection.limits: Selected examples are descriptive extreme/clear candidates, not a random validation sample. Raw example waveforms stay private.

protocol.gain_timing: Exports have no embedded gain-message timestamps. Within-run gain transitions are not inferred or certified by this screen.
protocol.task_event_alignment: Pending task event logs and verified trigger/clock mapping.

manual_review_status: Pending. Automatically selected plots are review candidates; no window has human acceptance.
